persons.name: Vīrabhadra
persons.residence: Rāmadila-puṇyāśrama on the hill (śaila) at Galkoṭa

notes: The phrase 'vīrabhadrasādhaka mumukṣuṇe(!) idaṃ pustakaṃ litaṃ(!)' (likely for mumukṣuṇā ... likhitam) is read as 'this book was written by Vīrabhadra, a sādhaka and mumukṣu', agreeing with the catalogue's scribe field; the corrupt ending could in principle be dative ('for a mumukṣu'), hence medium confidence for the scribe role. 'sādhaka' may be part of the name (Vīrabhadrasādhaka) or an ascetic designation; placed in titles. Place: 'muṇyāśrame' is a slip for puṇyāśrame (catalogue: Rāmadilapuṇyāśrama); 'daśruśaile' is obscure, perhaps the name of the hill at Galkoṭa. The year 1887 with 'miti', 'roja' and Devanagari script is Nepali Vikrama usage (VS 1887 = 1830 CE). Aṣṭāvakra muni is the legendary author of the text, listed only for filtering.
